This demonstration of fine-mapping will be done with the CACTA-like transposable element (TE) located on ZmPR4 as its exact position is known. Therefore we work with 2369 and LH123hT as both background parents and CML277 and CML341 as donor parents as they lack the TE which provide a higher expression of photoperiod-sensitivity. 


```{r get rp, dp, ZmPR list, echo=TRUE, message=T}

ZmPR_list <- 4 
rp_list <- c(1, 2) #"2369", "LH123Ht"
dp_list <-  c(3, 4) #"CML277", "CML341"

```

# Get phenotypic data 

Here we focus on slope of sensitivity (PS)

```{r load data, echo=TRUE, message=T}

groupA_NILs <- read.csv(paste0(genetic_data_save_path, "20240913Selected_NILs_after_filtration.csv"), header = T)
haplotype_slope <- read.csv(paste0(source_path, "haplotype_slope_20240921.csv"), header = T)

```

We keep only the genotypes introgressed in ZmPR 4 region (targeted region) and no other introgression in the background, meaning we work with NILs belonging to group A

```{r get the genotypes to work on}

### here all this should be done before this script 

geno_group <- group1_NILs  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", entryid)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", entryid)),
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", entryid))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rp %in% rp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dp %in% dp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(zmpr4_cacta == 1)

phenotype_zmpr4 <- haplotype_slope %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", haplotype)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", haplotype)),
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", haplotype))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(entryid2 = haplotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rp %in% rp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dp %in% dp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(NILAS_newid) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(id_new = as.factor(id_new), id_new = fct_rev(id_new)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(id_new)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(entryid2 %in% unique(haplotype_single_intro$entryid)) %>% ## keep only the NILs of group A
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = str_extract(entryid2, "i\\d+"),
    i = str_extract(i, "\\d{2}"),
    i = factor(
      i,
      levels = c(
        "12",
        "11",
        "10",
        "09",
        "08",
        "07",
        "06",
        "05",
        "04",
        "03",
        "02",
        "01"
      )
    ),
    marker = ifelse(
      entryid2 %in% candidate_gene_coordinate_sub$entryid,
      "yes",
      "no"
    ),
    marker = factor(marker, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  )

```

We transform the estimates so they are all positive, for that we apply a linear transformation by adding the absolute value of the most negative estimates to the other estimates. 

```{r}

min_value <- abs(min(phenotype_zmpr4$Estimate, na.rm = T))

phenotype_zmpr4 <- phenotype_zmpr4 %>%
  # dplyr::select(entryid2, Estimate, marker, id_new) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample  = entryid2) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, marker) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Estimate_transformed = Estimate + min_value,
    Estimate_of_origin = ifelse(Estimate_transformed < min_value, 0, Estimate),
    Addition = ifelse(Estimate < 0, min_value - abs(Estimate) , min_value),
    Sample = as.factor(Sample)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Estimate_of_origin, Addition),
                      names_to = "Type",
                      values_to = "values") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Estimate_transformed))

pheno_tot <- sum(phenotype_slope$Estimate_transformed, na.rm = T)

sample_order <- dput(levels(reorder(
  phenotype_zmpr4$Sample,
  desc(phenotype_zmpr4$Estimate_transformed)
)))

```

# Genotype

```{r load genotype data }

calculation_file <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% unique(haplotype_single_intro$entryid)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, marker) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dim_interval = i.end - i.start)

```

## Fine map  

```{r define interval number and interval size}

Number_interval = 200
Interval_size = (max(calculation_file$i.end, na.rm =T) - min(calculation_file$i.start, na.rm =T)) /Number_interval

```

```{r extract the begin and end base paire of each interval}

begin <- min(data1$i.start,  na.rm = T)
dataframe_interval  <- NULL 
interval <- 1
end <- 0
while(end < max(data1$i.end, na.rm = T )){
  end <-  begin + Interval_size
  list <- cbind(begin, end, interval)
  dataframe_interval <- rbind.data.frame(dataframe_interval, list)
  begin <- end + 1
  interval <- interval + 1
}

```

```{r define the interval value}

# Get mean size of segments in the targeted region of the NILs 
mean_interval <- mean(calculation_file$dim_interval, na.rm =T)

# Define in which the segment falls 
dataset2 <- dataframe_interval
interval_begin <- dataframe_interval$begin
interval_end <- dataframe_interval$end
dataset_final <- NULL

dataset_to_return <- NULL
table_for_fine_mapping <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(calculation_file, as.factor(calculation_file$Sample)), function(x)
  # x <- split(data2,as.factor(data2$Sample))[[1]]
{
  dataset_final <- NULL
  a <- 1
  for (i in 1:nrow(x)) {
    # i <- 16
    dataset1 <- x[i, ]
    snp_start <- x$i.start[i]
    snp_end <- x$i.end[i]
    interval_begin <- dataset2$begin[dataset2$interval == a]
    interval_end <- dataset2$end[dataset2$interval == a]
    if (snp_start < interval_end & snp_end > interval_end) {
      while (snp_end > interval_end) {
        print(a)
        a <- a + 1
        interval_begin <- dataset2$begin[dataset2$interval == a]
        interval_end <- dataset2$end[dataset2$interval == a]
        dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
        dataset_final <- rbind.data.frame(dataset_final, dataset1)
      }
      
  }else if (snp_start > interval_end) {
      while (snp_start > interval_end) {
        a <- a + 1
        interval_begin <- dataset2$begin[dataset2$interval == a]
        interval_end <- dataset2$end[dataset2$interval == a]
      }
      
      dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
      dataset_final <- rbind.data.frame(dataset_final, dataset1)
      
    } else {
      dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
      dataset_final <- rbind.data.frame(dataset_final, dataset1)
    }
    dataset_final
  }
  dataset_to_return <- rbind.data.frame(dataset_to_return, dataset_final)
  
}))

## calculate the value of the interval 
table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content <- table_for_fine_mapping %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, interval) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RP = sum(geno == "RP")/n(),
                DP = 1 - RP) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, RP, DP, interval) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() 

table_for_fine_mapping_interval_value <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% unique(haplotype_single_intro$entryid))%>%
  dplyr::full_join(phenotype_slope[,c("Sample", "Estimate_transformed")]) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval , Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value_inerval = DP * Estimate_transformed)%>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(value_inerval_tot = sum(value_inerval, na.rm = T)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value_inerval_tot  = value_inerval_tot/pheno_tot)
  
```
